title: Relief Against a Granite Ridge Retained Charge for Protection Held Over the Pass
content:
Where the household holds a Pass and Trip Protection plan written over a season pass on the account, part of the charge retained when a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass is given up is relieved.

**First.** Where the collective's protection records show a plan written over a season pass on the household account whose claim has been settled and whose season benefit runs to at least 80 in the hundred of the covered value, the charge is relieved by the excess that plan carries.

**Second.** Where those records show such a plan standing in force or with a claim open, the charge is relieved by half that excess, a share of 50 per cent of it.

**Otherwise.** In any other case no relief is given for protection the household holds.

### The plan records this rule reads

The plan is a Pass and Trip Protection record on the same household account whose covered holding is a season pass. Three things are read from it: the state it stands in, the share of the covered value its season benefit runs to, and the excess it carries.

| The plan written over a season pass on the household account | Its season benefit against the covered value | Relief given |
| --- | --- | --- |
| its claim has been settled | at least 80 in the hundred | the excess that plan carries |
| its claim has been settled | below 80 in the hundred | none by this rule |
| it stands in force | any | half that excess |
| it has a claim open | any | half that excess |
| no such plan on the account | not in question | none by this rule |

The threshold of 80 in the hundred is read only on the settled claim; a plan standing in force or with a claim open gives half the excess whatever share of the covered value its season benefit runs to.

### Worked on a hypothetical account

A household holding a Pass and Trip Protection plan over a Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass, with an excess of 150.00 and a season benefit running to 85 in the hundred of the covered value, on which a claim has been settled. The charge is relieved by 150.00. Where the same plan instead stood with a claim open, the charge would be relieved by 75.00.
